overview.description: The First Eagle Small Cap Equity ETF (FESC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in a focused portfolio of US small-cap companies. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing in companies it believes are trading below their intrinsic value and have identifiable catalysts for change. FESC was launched on Jun 30, 2026 and is issued by First Eagle.
